mapper.sql: pgroups.id AS id, companies.id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, pgroups.parent_id AS parentId, parent_pg.name AS parentName, pgroups.name AS `name`, pgroups.description AS description, pgroups.ics_apply_sub AS icsApplySub, pgroups.modified AS modified, pgroups.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM pgroups LEFT JOIN pgroups AS parent_pg ON pgroups.parent_id = parent_pg.id LEFT JOIN pgroup_companies AS pc ON pc.pgroup_id = pgroups.id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = pc.company_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = pgroups.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = pgroups.modified_by

WHERE pgroups.is_active = 1 AND pc.pgroup_id = pgroups.id
AND pgroups.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR parent_pg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.select: SELECT chart_accounts.id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes,' - ',chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, pgroup_accounts.account_type_id AS accountTypeId, account_types.name AS accountTypeName FROM pgroup_accounts INNER JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = pgroup_accounts.chart_account_id INNER JOIN account_types ON account_types.id = pgroup_accounts.account_type_id WHERE pgroup_id = #{id}
SELECT product_pgroups.product_id AS id, products.name AS name FROM product_pgroups INNER JOIN products ON products.id = product_pgroups.product_id WHERE product_pgroups.pgroup_id = #{id}

SELECT user_pgroups.user_id AS id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS name FROM user_pgroups INNER JOIN employees ON employees.user_id = user_pgroups.user_id WHERE user_pgroups.pgroup_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: pgroups.id AS id, companies.id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, pgroups.parent_id AS parentId, (SELECT pg.`name` FROM pgroups AS pg WHERE pg.id = pgroups.parent_id) AS parentName, pgroups.name AS `name`, pgroups.description AS description, pgroups.user_apply AS userApply, pgroups.ics_apply_sub AS icsApplySub, pgroups.modified AS modified, pgroups.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM pgroups LEFT JOIN pgroup_companies AS pc ON pc.pgroup_id = pgroups.id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = pc.company_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = pgroups.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = pgroups.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pgroups ( sys_code, parent_id, name, user_apply, ics_apply_sub, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{productGroup.parentId}, #{productGroup.name}, #{productGroup.userApply}, #{productGroup.icsApplySub}, #{productGroup.description}, NOW(), #{productGroup.createdBy}, #{productGroup.isActive} )
mapper.select: SELECT price_types.id AS id, price_types.name AS name, pgroup_prices.percent AS percent, pgroup_prices.add_on AS addOn, pgroup_prices.set_type AS setType, pgroup_prices.from_cost AS fromCost, pgroup_prices.to_cost AS toCost FROM price_types LEFT JOIN pgroup_prices ON pgroup_prices.price_type_id = price_types.id AND pgroup_prices.pgroup_id = #{id} AND pgroup_prices.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN price_type_companies ON price_type_companies.price_type_id = price_types.id AND price_type_companies.company_id IN ( SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId}) WHERE price_types.is_active = 1;
